task.text: The broker redelivers messages, and each redelivery credits the account again.
Fix `AccountConsumer.handle(Deposit)` so handling a message twice has the effect of handling it once. `Deposit` and `Ledger` are given; the constructor stays.

items: Return `true` when the deposit was applied, `false` for a message id already processed.
Identify a message by `messageId`, not by its content.
If `ledger.credit` throws, the id must **not** count as processed: the redelivery has to be applied.
The same message arriving on several threads at once is applied exactly once; different messages must not be lost.

checks.title: Same content, different id, is new
A failed effect can be retried

hints.text: At-least-once delivery means the consumer must remember which message ids it has handled. Check, apply and mark are one step: nothing may come between them.
Keep a `Set<String>` of processed ids. Look the id up, call `ledger.credit`, and only then add the id, all inside one critical section. If `credit` throws, the id is never added.
